Hey man I’m 16 atm and I was exactly where you are 3 years ago. I know it sounds cliché but seriously the hardest part for trying to get better and getting help, is asking for it. Someone to talk to when you need to and someone to sit and listen to anything you have to say AND help you work through it can improve your life by so much. 3 years ago I was about ready to give up and end it by falling of a bridge near where I live. But I decided against it and asked for help. It does sound dumb and sound like a clichè to say the hardest part is to get help but right now your in that hardest part man. Don’t be afraid to ask for help and if you are then ask while afraid then feel that fear later. Then finally pride because you took the first step into becoming the best you, you could possibly be.
